title: Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank Q2 net profit rises 31%
summary: Impairment charges declined 55% YoY to AED638 million
thbAction: Map the news to THB's provider CRM for referral growth, patient lifecycle engagement, and multi-facility relationship management across hospital and provider networks.
contentHtml:
Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank's (ADCB) second-quarter 2026 net profit jumped 31% year-on-year (YoY) to AED 3.4 billion.

Impairment charges declined 55% YoY to AED638 million

Staff Writer ,  ZAWYA

Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank's (ADCB) second-quarter 2026 net profit jumped 31% year-on-year (YoY) to AED 3.4 billion ($926 million), driven by higher non-interest income and lower impairment charges.
